title: Fermat's Last Theorem in Lean 4
summary: A complete, machine-checked Lean 4 proof of Fermat's Last Theorem, built on Mathlib: for every natural number n >= 3 there are no positive natural numbers a, b, c with a^n + b^n = c^n (declaration fermat_last_theorem). The default build target also derives Mathlib's own statement FermatLastTheorem. The argument is that of Frey, Serre, Ribet, Wiles and Taylor-Wiles; the named classical inputs (irreducibility of the Frey representation, Langlands-Tunnell, modularity lifting, modularity of semistable curves, level lowering) are proved within the development, in the strength the argument needs,…
